yehovaa vaakku amitthayi kumaarudaina yonaaku pratyakshamai yeelaagu selavicchenu.
neenevepatta nasthula doshamu naa drushtiki ghoramaayenu ganuka neevu lechi neeneve mahaa pattanamunaku poyi daaniki durgathi kalugunani prakatimpumu.

ayithe yehovaa sanni dhilonundi tharsheeshu pattanamunaku paaripovalenani yonaa yoppeku poyi tharsheeshunaku povu oka odanu chuchi, prayaanamunaku kevu ichi, yehovaa sannidhilo niluvaka odavaarithookoodi tharsheeshunaku povutaku oda ekkenu.
ayithe yehovaa samudramumeeda pedda gaali puttimpagaa samudramandu goppa thupaanu regi oda baddalaipovugathi vacchenu.

kaabatti naavikulu bhaya padi, prathivaadunu thana thana dhevathanu praarthinchi, oda chulakana cheyutakai anduloni sarakulanu samudramulo paaravesiri. Appatiki yonaa, oda diguvabhaagamunaku poyi pandukoni gaadha nidrapoyiyundenu
appudu odanaayakudu athani yoddhaku vachi, oyee nidra bothaa, neekemivachinadhi? Lechi nee dhevuni praarthinchumu, manamu chaavakunda aa dhevudu manayandu kanikarinchu nemo anenu.
anthalo oda vaaru evaninibatti intha keedu manaku sambhavinchinadhi teliyutakai manamu chitlu vethamu randani yokarithoo okaru cheppukoni, chitlu veyagaa chiti yonaameediki vacchenu.
kaabatti vaaru athani chuchi yevarinibatti ee keedu maaku sambhavincheno, nee vyaapaaramemito, nee vekkadanundi vachithivo, nee dheshamedo, nee janamedo, yee sangathi yanthayu maaku teliyajeyumanagaa
athadu vaarithoo itlanenu nenu hebreeyudanu; samudramunakunu bhoomikini srushtikarthayai aakaashamandundu dhevudaiyunna yehovaayandu nenu bhayabhakthulugala vaadanai yunnaanu.
thaanu yehovaa sannidhilonundi paari povuchunnattu athadu aa manushyulaku teliyajesi yundenu ganuka vaaraa sangathi telisikoni marintha bhaya padineevu chesina pani emani athani nadigiri.
appudu vaarusamudramu ponguchunnadhi, thupaanu adhikamauchunnadhi, samudramu maameediki raakunda nimmalinchunatlu memu nee kemi cheyavalenani athani nadugagaa yonaa
nannubattiye yee goppathupaanu meemeedikivacchenani naaku telisiyunnadhi; nannu etthi samudramulo padaveyudi, appudu samudramu meemeediki raakunda nimmalinchunani athadu vaarithoo cheppinanu
vaaru odanu dariki techu taku tedlanu bahu balamugaa vesirigaani gaali thamaku edurai thupaanu balamuchetha samudramu pongiyunduta valana vaari prayatnamu vyarthamaayenu.

kaabatti vaaru yehovaa, nee chitthaprakaaramugaa neeve deeni chesithivi; ee manushyunibatti mammunu layamu cheyakunduvu gaaka; nirdoshini champithiranna neramu maameeda mopakunduvu gaaka ani yehovaaku manavi chesikoni
yonaanu etthi samudramulo padavesiri; padaveyagaane samudramu pongakunda aagenu.
idi choodagaa aa manushyulu yehovaaku migula bhayapadi, aayanaku bali arpinchi mrokkuballu chesiri.
goppa matsyamu okati yonaanu mingavalenani yehovaa niyaminchi yundagaa yonaa moodu dinamulu aa matsyamu yokka kadupulo nundenu.
aa matsyamu kadupulonundi yonaa yehovaanu eelaaguna praarthinchenu.
nenu upadravamulo undi yehovaaku manavicheyagaa aayana naaku pratyuttharamicchenu; paathaalagarbhamulonundi nenu kekalu veyagaa neevu naa praarthana nangeekarinchiyunnaavu.
neevu nannu agaadhamaina samudragarbhamulo padavesi yunnaavu, pravaahamulu nannu chuttukoniyunnavi, nee tharangamulunu nee karullunu nannu kappiyunnavi.
nee sannidhilonundi nenu veliveyabadinanu, nee parishuddhaalayamuthattu marala chuchedhananukontini.
praanaanthamu vachunanthagaa jalamulu nannu chuttu koniyunnavi, samudraagaadhamu nannu aavarinchiyunnadhi. Samudrapunaachu naa thalakuchuttukoni yunnadhi.
nenu marenna tikini ekkiraakunda bhoomi gadiyalu veyabadiyunnavi; parvathamula punaadulaloniki nenu digiyunnaanu, naa dhevaa, yehovaa, neevu naa praanamu koopamulonundi paiki rappinchiyunnaavu.
koopamulonundi naa praanamu naalo moorchillagaa nenu yehovaanu gnaapakamu chesi kontini; nee parishuddhaalayamuloniki neeyoddhaku naa manavi vacchenu.
asatyamaina vyarthadhevathalayandu lakshyamunchuvaaru thama krupaadhaaramunu visarjinthuru.
kruthagnathaasthuthulu chellinchi nenu neeku balula narpinthunu, nenu mrokkukonina mrokkuballanu chellimpaka maananu. Yehovaayoddhane rakshana dorakunu ani praarthinchenu.
anthalo yehovaa matsyamunaku aagna iyyagaa adhi yonaanu nelameeda kakkivesenu.
anthata yehovaa vaakku rendava maaru yonaaku pratyakshamai selavichinadhemanagaa
neevu lechi neeneve mahaapuramunaku poyi nenu neeku teliyajeyu samaa chaaramu daaniki prakatana cheyumu.
kaabatti yonaa lechi yehovaa selavichina aagnaprakaaramu neeneve pattana munaku poyenu. neeneve pattanamu dhevuni drushtiki goppadai moodu dinamula prayaanamantha parimaanamugala pattanamu.
yonaa aa pattanamulo oka dina prayaana manthadooramu sancharinchuchu ika naluvadhi dinamulaku neeneve pattanamu naashanamagunani prakatanacheyagaa
neeneve pattanapuvaaru dhevuniyandu vishvaasamunchi upavaasa dinamu chaatinchi, ghanulemi alpulemi andarunu gone patta kattukoniri.
aa sangathi neeneve raajunaku vinabadi nappudu athadunu thana sinhaasanamu meedanundi digi,thana raajavastramulu theesivesi gonepatta kattukoni boodidelo koorchundenu.
mariyu raajaina thaanunu aayana mantrulunu aagna iyyagaa

okavela dhevudu manassu trippukoni pashchaatthapthudai manamu layamukaakunda thana kopaagni challaarchukonunu ganuka manushyulu ediyu puchukona koodadu, pashuvulu gaani yeddulugaani gorrelugaani metha meyakoodadu, neellu traagakoodadu,

manushyu landaru thama durmaargamulanu vidichi thaamu cheyu balaatkaaramunu maaniveyavalenu, manushyulemi pashuvulemi samasthamunu gonepatta kattukonavalenu, janulu manaḥpoorva kamugaa dhevuni vedukonavalenu ani doothalu neeneve pattanamulo chaatinchi prakatana chesiri.
ee neeneve vaaru thama chedu nadathalanu maanukonagaa vaaru cheyuchunna kriyalanu dhevudu chuchi pashchaatthapthudai vaariki cheyudu nani thaanu maata yichina keeducheyaka maanenu.
yonaa deenichuchi bahu chinthaakraanthudai kopaginchukoni

yehovaa, nenu naa dheshamandundagaa itlu jarugunani nenanukontini gadaa? Andu valanane neevu kataakshamunu jaaliyunu bahu shaanthamunu atyantha krupayugala dhevudavai yundi, pashchaatthaapapadi keeducheyaka maanuduvani nenu telisikoni daaniki mundu gaane tharsheeshunaku paaripothini.
nenika bradukutakante chachuta melu; yehovaa, nannika bradukaniyyaka champumani yehovaaku manavi chesenu.
anduku yehovaa neevu kopinchuta nyaayamaa? Ani yadigenu.
appudu yonaa aa pattanamulonundi poyi daani thoorputhattuna basachesi acchata pandili yokati vesikoni pattanamunaku emi sambhavinchuno chuchedhanani aa needanu koorchuni yundagaa
dhevudaina yehovaa sorachettokati erparachi athaniki kaligina shrama pogottutakai adhi perigi yonaa thalakupaigaa needa yichunatlu chesenu; aa sora chettunu chuchi yonaa bahu santhooshinchenu.
marusati udayamandu dhevudu oka purugunu erparachagaa adhi aa chettunu tolichinanduna chettu vaadipoyenu.
mariyu enda kaayagaa dhevudu vedimigala thoorpugaalini rappiṁ chenu. Yonaathalaku enda debba thagalagaa athadu somma sillibradukutakante chachuta naaku melanukonenu.
appudu dhevudu'ee sorachettunu gurinchi neevu kopinchuta nyaayamaa? Ani yonaanu adugagaa yonaapraanamu povunanthagaa kopinchuta nyaayame anenu.
anduku yehovaaneevu kashtapadakundanu penchakundanu oka raatrilone putti perigi oka raatrilo gaane vaadi poyina yee sorachettu vishayamulo neevu vichaarapadu chunnaave;
ayithe noota iruvadhivelakante ekkuvai, kudiyedamalu erugani janamunu bahu pashuvulunu gala neeneve mahaapuramu vishayamulo nenu vichaarapadavaddaa? Ani yonaathoo selavicchenu.
